The PT2258 is a dedicated 6-channel electronic volume controller IC manufactured by Princeton Technology Corp, built using CMOS technology for multi-channels audio and video systems.
Key Specifications & Features
Channels: 6 independent input and output audio channels.
Attenuation Range: 0 dB to -79 dB in precise 1 dB steps.
Control Interface: I2C Bus Control Interface supporting up to 4 selectable addresses on a single bus.
Operating Voltage: 5V to 9V DC.
Audio Performance: Signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) greater than 100 dB (A-weighting) and low total harmonic distortion.
Package Type: 20-pin DIP or SOP.
